Call (727) 555-0188

Jobs sent to your phone. Billing handled. You keep 90%.

Boat owners in Pinellas, Hillsborough and Pasco post jobs. We screen them and offer each one to the two or three best-matched mechanics. You take the ones you want.

How it works for you

  • Free to join. No monthly fee and no lead fees.
  • You set your rates and edit every quote before it goes out.
  • Decline anything, with no penalty.
  • We collect from the customer by bank or card and pay you 90% when it clears, usually within a week. No chasing invoices.
  • Upload any invoice. A photo of a paper ticket is fine; we read it.

What we ask

  • Commercial general liability insurance, $1 million, with the certificate on file
  • A W-9 before your first payout
  • Your own truck, tools and parts sourcing
  • A call to the customer within the hour after you accept a job
  • Written quotes, and you honor them
  • Customers we introduce run through the platform for 12 months

You stay an independent business. Read the customer terms, and ask for the mechanic agreement before you accept your first job.
